title: AppFlow drift recovery must be part of a clean VIXEN build
body: Extends existing cx-gpuwin5 proposal b5f3114f7c6a45820978a4dc53ea101fc7cddf0: on this fresh WSL Release configure at pinned kernel 6e347432, appflow_check was stale and required the documented appflow_regen target before the remaining checks could run; the committed AppFlow.appflow was unchanged and only the generated header gained the emitter's noexcept contract. The normal build should validate or regenerate the header from the same pinned generator without a lane-side recovery step. Tier luna: one build/codegen dependency fix with an obvious witness.
